headline: From Europe to Asia, floods to heatwaves, world experiences weather shocks
context: At least eight people died in Japan as heavy rains flooded roads and disrupted traffic while firefighters from Britain to France and Croatia struggled to contain blazes in Europe's fifth heatwave this summer
